PreferenceMapping 0.1.0
  • Reference

    Main wrapper for Preference Mapping methods

    PreferenceMapping.Rd

    Unified interface to compute Internal, External, Restricted Unfolding, and PrefMaX preference mapping analyses across one or multiple dimensions.

    PreferenceMapping(
  file_path,
  method = c("internal", "external", "restricted", "prefmax"),
  sheet_liking = NULL,
  sheet_products = NULL,
  sheet_subjects = NULL,
  ndim = 2,
  max_dim = NULL,
  clustering = TRUE,
  n_clusters = NULL,
  max_k = 6,
  scale.unit = FALSE,
  scale_desc = 1,
  scale_subj = 1,
  min_r2 = 1,
  ridge_x = 0.001,
  ridge_y = 0.001,
  type_unfold = "ordinal",
  conditionality = "row",
  method_diss = "reverse",
  itmax = 10000,
  label_consumers = FALSE,
  plot3D = FALSE,
  short_id = NULL,
  out_dir = NULL,
  save_tiff = TRUE,
  dpi = 300,
  sheet_hedo = NULL,
  sheet_qda = NULL,
  ...
)

    Arguments

    file_path

    Path to the Excel input file (.xlsx or .xls).

    method

    Vector of methods to compute: "internal", "external", "restricted", "restricted_prod", "restricted_subj", "restricted_both", or "prefmax".

    sheet_liking

    Name of the sheet containing consumer liking data (required).

    sheet_products

    Name of the sheet containing product variables.

    sheet_subjects

    Name of the sheet containing consumer variables.

    ndim

    Starting dimension for analysis (default: 2).

    max_dim

    Maximum dimension for analysis. If specified, iterates from ndim to max_dim.

    clustering

    Logical. Performs consumer clustering if TRUE (default: TRUE).

    n_clusters

    Numeric. Forced number of clusters.

    max_k

    Maximum number of clusters tested during Silhouette search (default: 6).

    scale.unit

    Logical. Standardizes product variables in PrefMaX if TRUE (default: FALSE).

    scale_desc

    Scale factor for product variable vectors on biplots (default: 1).

    scale_subj

    Scale factor for consumer background variables on biplots (default: 1).

    min_r2

    Minimum R2 threshold to display product variables on biplots (default: 1.0).

    ridge_x

    Ridge regularization parameter for product constraints in Unfolding (default: 1e-3).

    ridge_y

    Ridge regularization parameter for subject constraints in Unfolding (default: 1e-3).

    type_unfold

    Unfolding transformation type for smacofRect (default: "ordinal").

    conditionality

    Matrix conditionality for smacofRect (default: "row").

    method_diss

    Dissimilarity conversion method for sim2diss (default: "reverse").

    itmax

    Maximum number of iterations for smacofRect algorithm (default: 10000).

    label_consumers

    Logical. Displays individual consumer labels on biplots if TRUE (default: FALSE).

    plot3D

    Logical. Generates an interactive 3D plot for Unfolding if TRUE (default: FALSE).

    short_id

    Short identifier string for exported file naming.

    out_dir

    Output directory path. If NULL, uses input file directory.

    save_tiff

    Logical. Exports biplot figures as TIFF images if TRUE (default: TRUE).

    dpi

    Image resolution in DPI for saved TIFF files (default: 300).

    sheet_hedo

    Legacy alias for sheet_liking.

    sheet_qda

    Legacy alias for sheet_products.

    ...

    Additional optional arguments.

    Value

    An object of class preference_mapping_multi containing results and ggplot objects.
